name: Complete a coding lesson and retain progress
description: Verifies a correct answer completes a lesson, awards XP once, and preserves progress after refresh.
steps: Enter the correct example and check the answer
expected: The lesson remains complete, XP is awarded once, and progress is still visible after refresh.

name: Browse courses and achievements
description: Verifies learners can browse the course tracks and see achievements update from completed lessons.
steps: Search for Python and select it
Open Achievements and review the unlocked progress
expected: The selected course lessons are available and achievement progress reflects the completed lesson.

name: Run a code playground preview
description: Verifies the learner can edit HTML, run a preview, and restore the starter example.
steps: Enter a heading in the HTML editor
expected: The preview displays the entered heading and Reset restores the starter HTML example.

name: Show feedback for an incorrect lesson answer
description: Verifies incorrect answers are not rewarded and learners can request a useful hint.
expected: An incorrect-answer message and a useful hint appear, and XP does not increase.

name: Change and retain app settings
covers: app logo and launch splash branding
app icon and hero image visibility
description: Verifies the settings entry opens a working preferences page and saved appearance choices persist across reloads.
steps: Open Settings using the sidebar settings button
Choose Large text and enable Reduce motion
Refresh the app and reopen Settings
expected: Settings opens, each control changes its corresponding appearance preference, and the selected settings remain after refresh. The app launch screen and home branding display the uploaded logo, icon, and hero image.
